summary: bcache_cost_hosttest.c's cost rows, with faults in rach2/sys/fs/bcache.c that change the buffers walked or the batches written

argv:
set -e
t=${WORK}/tree
rm -rf "$t"
mkdir -p "$t/rach2" "$t/tests/host"
cp -R rach2/sys "$t/rach2/sys"
cp -R tests/host/compat "$t/tests/host/compat"
cp tests/host/bcache_cost_hosttest.c "$t/tests/host/"
cp -R ${SRC}/. "$t/"
cd "$t"
for x in bcache_cost_hosttest; do
    deps=$(grep -oE 'host-deps:[^*]*' tests/host/$x.c | sed 's/host-deps://' | tr '\n' ' ')
    ${CC:-cc} -std=c99 -D_DEFAULT_SOURCE -D_FORTIFY_SOURCE=0 -DRACH2_HOSTTEST -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=all -g -O1 -Wno-empty-body -ffreestanding -I rach2/sys -I rach2/sys/lib -I rach2/sys/proc -I tests/host/compat -o ${WORK}/$x tests/host/$x.c $deps
done

faults.name: hold-walk
faults.summary: the hold rules that walk every buffer of the cache on every get

lines: FAIL: a hit with three buffers held reads its holds and its own buffer, not the cache

faults.name: victim-walk
faults.summary: a victim chosen by a walk of every buffer

lines: FAIL: a miss on a full cache reads the head of the release order, not the cache

faults.name: sync-rescan
faults.summary: a sync's batch of one block, which walks the cache again for every run

edits.find: rc = sync_batches(dev, pass, flags, first_flags, batch, (int)(pages * (PAGE_SIZE / 8u)));
edits.replace: rc = sync_batches(dev, pass, flags, first_flags, batch, 1);

lines: FAIL: a sync gathers its dirty blocks in one walk and sorts them in a heap
FAIL: without room for one batch, a sync reads the cache once for each 128 dirty blocks, not once for each run, and sorts each batch in a heap

faults.name: insertion-sort
faults.summary: a batch kept by insertion sort, which shifts it for each block written in order

lines: FAIL: a sync gathers its dirty blocks in one walk and sorts them in a heap
FAIL: without room for one batch, a sync reads the cache once for each 128 dirty blocks, not once for each run, and sorts each batch in a heap

faults.name: small-batch
faults.summary: a sync that gathers 128 blocks a walk whatever room the heap has

lines: FAIL: a sync gathers its dirty blocks in one walk and sorts them in a heap

faults.name: cap
faults.summary: a cache without its cap at half the kernel heap's pages

lines: FAIL: a machine whose memory share passes the kernel heap has a cache of half the heap's pages
FAIL: a heap of another size has a cache of half its own pages

faults.name: fixed-cap
faults.summary: a cap at half of i686's heap region, whatever the heap's region is

lines: FAIL: a heap of another size has a cache of half its own pages
FAIL: the counter counts the buffers a hit and its release read
FAIL: the counter counts the buffers each miss and its release read
FAIL: the counter counts the sync's two walks of the dirty list
FAIL: the counter counts the batched sync's walks of the dirty list
